clock: fictional minutes, no progress from reading time

rules.description: Passing the gate and reaching the road takes two minutes in the demo. This duration describes no canonical distance.
Waiting advances the clock by the chosen whole number of minutes.
Actions without a deterministic rule produce a proposal to arbitrate; no success or roll is invented.
An expense cannot make a resource negative. Costs come from an explicit rule.
An expired effect is removed by a distinct event and logged at its fictional deadline.
